additions.note: Multimodal decision model for classification, yes/no evaluation and scoring over text, images and sampled video frames. Quality model is available through HeyGen's API; its Turbo companion remains a preview in the publisher's documentation.

Public access to the existing spatial world model through Viewfinder, Chisel and developer APIs, for generating or reconstructing worlds and exporting images, video or 3D Gaussian splats. An availability milestone rather than a new model version or an open-weight release.

Four Apache-2.0 decision models classify or score inputs against supplied criteria and return probabilities instead of free-form answers. Public merged weights cover 4B, 7B-v3.0, 11B-v3.0 and 11B-v3.1 variants, with adapter releases alongside them.

Open-weight on-device mixture-of-experts models released with an inference framework for local coding, reasoning, and agents. The 145B model activates about 10B parameters per step. Quantized checkpoints use the Edge0 Community Model License 1.0; memory, speed, and benchmark figures in the announcement are vendor measurements.

Generally available fast Gemini 4 model for everyday coding and agent workflows, with a 1M-token context window and configurable thinking. Available through free and paid Gemini API and AI Studio tiers, the Gemini app and Search; Antigravity access requires Google AI Pro or Ultra.

Two Apache-2.0 experimental instruction-model previews trained to consume and generate LLMON markup. Explicit blocks and execution pointers bind instructions to data, separating trusted instructions from documents and tool results; IBM reports improved indirect prompt-injection robustness on its evaluated benchmarks.

Updated computer-use model for end-to-end web tasks begins rolling out to Hark Pro users. Hark reports a faster trained model and additional backend speed improvements; its task-completion results are internal benchmarks.

Public multimodal encoder for text, image, video and document retrieval and structured decisions. Downloadable weights and a Transformers wrapper expose encode, retrieve and decide calls with 6,656-dimensional embeddings.

additions.model: Perplexity Decider v1.3 / Decider Flash v1.3
additions.note: Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models add Locate extraction of exact text spans with character offsets and confidence. Available through the Decisions API and OpenRouter, with public ungated weights for both the Qwen3.8-27B-based model and its smaller Qwen3.5-4B-based distilled companion.

Apache-2.0 open speech-augmented language model for non-streaming transcription, with multilingual support, natural-language transcription style control and context biasing. Combines a Whisper audio encoder with a Gemma 4 mixture-of-experts backbone.

DNA sequence model conditioned on cell type or state to predict gene regulation and variant effects. Available through the AlphaGenome API for non-commercial research, with commercial research in private preview. A research model, not validated for clinical or diagnostic use.

Open weights, inference and fine-tuning code under Apache-2.0 for the 27B world action model, which predicts video and actions. The base checkpoint requires embodiment-specific heads and fine-tuning for robot control.

Healthcare transcription model named at ElevenLabs Summit NYC, tuned for medical terminology. The announcement does not establish a separate API model ID or general availability milestone; the November 10 Scribe launch already mentioned a medical variant of v3 Live in ElevenAgents.

Recorded-audio and realtime speech-to-text models with speaker diarization, multilingual transcription and terminology controls. Both launched in ElevenAPI and the ElevenLabs app; Live also launched in ElevenAgents.

World-action models jointly predicting future video and robot actions for dexterous manipulation and whole-body control. Introduced at CoRL; the research page schedules code for December, so this is an announcement rather than a downloadable-weight release.

MIT-licensed weights for the native multimodal mixture-of-experts model, including a W4A4 quantized companion, following the November 2 hosted release. Publisher describes 1.6T total and approximately 48B active parameters; deployment documentation targets NPU inference.
